AI/ML API AI/ML API


** Introducing JevRouter
------------------------------------------------------------

Now you can cut your LLM costs by up to 80%

Hi,

Our own router is live! We built JevRouter (https://aimlapi.com/jev-router?utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6442e901fd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_29_06_35_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-1155ef5a03-1373035900) on TypeSafe's Jev decision model. It picks the best-value model for every chat request: low-cost models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for easy work, Claude Opus 5.5 or GPT-6 Astra for the hard stuff.

Why it's a big deal:

• Pay up to 80% less than sending every request to Claude Opus 5.5.

• 10 top models in 3 tiers, from DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.

• Quick response: easy requests go to lightweight flash models.

• Get answers even when a model or its providers fail: a stronger same-tier model steps in.

model = "aimlapi/jev-router"

Same API key, same endpoint: just change the model name. You pay the answering model's rate plus one Jev decision.

View Docs (https://docs.aimlapi.com/api-references/text-models-llm/aimlapi/jev-router?utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6442e901fd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_29_06_35_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-1155ef5a03-1373035900)
Try JevRouter (https://aimlapi.com/jev-router?utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6442e901fd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_29_06_35_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-1155ef5a03-1373035900)

Best regards,

AI/ML API Team

P.S. Curious how a different router would handle your requests? LiquidRouter is a separate router on AI/ML API, built on Liquid AI's d1 decision model: it rates each request's difficulty in one call with zero output tokens, then sends easy work to low-cost models and hard work to top ones. Have a look at LiquidRouter (https://aimlapi.com/liquid-router?utm_source=AI%2FML+API+Customers&utm_campaign=6442e901fd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_29_06_35_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-1155ef5a03-1373035900) and compare for yourself.

memorii.titlu: [GMAIL] Updates to Stripe’s legal terms and Privacy Policy
memorii.detalii:
De la: Stripe <notifications@stripe.com>
Data: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 19:15:26 +0000
Subiect: Updates to Stripe’s legal terms and Privacy Policy

Conținut:
Legal terms and Privacy Policy updates

We’re updating Stripe’s legal terms and Privacy Policy. Here’s what’s changing:

Updates to the Stripe Services Agreement

We’re updating our online legal terms to reflect improvements to our products and services, support new capabilities, and clarify how we provide our services to you. You don’t need to take any action. The updates will take effect for you on January 6, 2027. By keeping your account open after this date, you agree to the updated terms.

Review the updated Stripe Connected Account Agreement (https://stripe.com/legal/connect-account) (incorporating the Stripe Services Agreement (https://stripe.com/legal/ssa)) and visit our support page (https://support.stripe.com/questions/stripe-user-terms-update-september-28-2026) for more information, including what you can do if you don’t accept this update.

Updates to the Privacy Policy

We’re updating our Privacy Policy (https://stripe.com/privacy/preview) to provide you with more transparency and greater control over your personal information. The updated privacy policy will go into effect on November 20, 2026. Key changes include:

- Updates to data processing covering agentic payments, stablecoin/blockchain transactions, platform-branded Issuing cards, machine learning risk predictions, insights shared with business users, lead data, and third-party app sync (with Link moved to a separate Link Privacy Policy).

- Clarifications on Stripe’s data roles, including our independent data controller status across Atlas, Connect, and Capital, as well as new terms for Merchant of Record services.

- Updates to communication policies covering automated dialing, AI voice agents, and transcripts for outreach and model training.

- Updates to regional terms reflecting new local regulations and global expansion.

Review the updated Privacy Policy (https://stripe.com/privacy/preview) to see all changes. If you have any questions, visit our Privacy Center (https://stripe.com/privacy-center/legal) or contact us (privacy@stripe.com).
